note: AGE-RESTRICTED: 55+ (senior park). Rural senior mobile-home & RV park SW of Arcadia catering to full-time residents and snowbirds; canoe launch and boat slips, minutes from county boat ramps to the Peace River. Call for availability. --Claude
summary: Operator's rate page (effective May 1, 2026): $70 regular / $80 super site per night, full hookups with electric included; laundry; Passport America 50% off May-October. Not stated: amps, site count, rig length, booking channel (call). Good Sam false (derived) left.
flags: Price gate: $70/night base (operator's rate page effective May 1, 2026) is over US$50; not stayed, Arcadia is no gateway. Passport America's 50% (May-October only) is not a Good Sam discount.

Long-stay / residential (five-test rule): the operator calls it a 'senior park' and 'Early Retirement Active Resort Community' that caters to 'mobile home owners, park model owners ... full time residents and snowbirds', with properties for sale ('VIEW AVAILABLE PROPERTIES'), an annual-season rate, and nights only by phone - looks mostly residential/seasonal.
Waterfront re-audit lead (weak): the operator lists 'Water access & canoe launch' and boat slips ($20/month) on the property; the entry is 'not waterfront'.
